searchText: <@&1458826346896687229> https://github.com/ethereum/builder-specs/pull/168 any objections to this? we wanna avoid that small operator errors, like adding a trailing slash can cause `auth.data` mismatches. The only caveat I can think of with this is that you cannot sign over the pubkey if it's part of the url, but there is always the option for builders to provide custom auth data that operators then configure instead. but I think hostname should be sufficient for the builder to uniquely be addressed if A is not weak when? at the point the builder should release the execution payload? that point is not defined. the time allowed for propogation of all other messages is 3 seconds (e.g. attestation deadline to aggregation) - so is 3s allowed for execution payload? and so is the weakness / strength evaluation going to be based off attestations seen at 3s into the block? Or is the evaluation going to be made by nodes later with the benefit of full attestation information? I think the answer is that nodes evaluate this at the end of the slot, but would be good to clarify. The evaluation happens at the beginning of the next slot when the proposer chooses the block to build against
